text:
St. Louis has a goalie question, and it's the opposite of the one most teams have. Jordan Binnington's name is all over trade-rumor sites, with outlets listing destinations and Elliotte Friedman weighing in on Edmonton's interest, as reported by Sportskeeda. He hasn't helped his case on the ice: .843 and 3.9 goals worse than expected over his last five starts. Meanwhile Joel Hofer is at .932 and 5.4 goals better than expected over his last five, including a 1-0 shootout win over Utah.

The team in front of them is about as average as it gets. The Blues are 10-9-2 with 22 points, almost exactly the 22.5 our expected points say they've earned, with 50% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and 51% at five on five. The Robert Thomas, Dylan Holloway and Jimmy Snuggerud line is the most used, at 52% with goals even at 7-7, and Snuggerud has been a popular fantasy pickup. Cam Fowler and Brandon Carlo drive play (58%) but have been on for 11 goals against and 6 for, a gap that has more to do with saves than structure.

Logan Mailloux is back from injury. Our numbers give Jim Montgomery's team 38% playoff odds. Who starts in net, and whether Binnington is still in St. Louis by spring, is the thread to follow.
